about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - Guns & Gears (Remastered)


Gear Up and Throw Down!


When sword and spell just won't be enough to win the day, it's time to power up your game with clockwork gears, lightning coils, and black powder! Guns & Gears (Remastered), the latest hardcover rulebook for the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game, brings the excitement of firearms and fantasy technology to your tabletop, updated to work perfectly with the remastered Pathfinder Second Edition rules!

Unravel the secrets of clockworks with the new inventor class or blow away your opposition as a firearm-wielding gunslinger! In addition to new classes, a plethora of archetypes, backgrounds, vehicles, siege engines, gadgets, and the remastered automaton ancestry are all ready to expand your game with options for battlefields large and small.

Pathfinder RPG: Guns & Gears (Remastered) features:

<ul> <li> Two new classes: the clever inventor and the sharpshooting gunslinger, updated to work perfectly with the Remastered Pathfinder Second Edition rules</li>
<li> The remastered automaton ancestry for players who want to play a customizable construct</li>
<li> Firearms of all stripes, from the simple and effective flintlock pistol to versatile gunblades</li>
<li> Dozens of new archetypes</li>
<li> Scores of new gadgets and vehicles</li>
<li> Siege engines and accompanying rules</li>
<li> A gazetteer of Golarion revealing how firearms and technology fit into the Age of Lost Omens, including a look at the technology of the continents of Arcadia and Tian Xia and never-before-revealed secrets of the rough-and-tumble, gritty city of Alkenstar</li>
<li> Special categories of items that can give you power that comes at a dangerous price.</li>
</ul> This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

<ul> <li> Includes a Fantasy Grounds reference manual providing all of the guidebook content.</li>
<li> Integrated automation to make using the new features even easier.</li>
<li> Beautifully crafted images with rich details giving visuals to accompany the information that comes in the book.</li>
</ul>
Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Bret Davenport

Requires: An active subscription or a one time purchase of a Fantasy Grounds license and the Pathfinder 2.0 ruleset.

Screenshots may differ from what you see in-game based on the extension and ruleset you have loaded.
